name: Student gamer on a budget
description: aged 18 to 24, student or entry-level worker, saves for months to afford a laptop, games on an old laptop or console, reads reviews on YouTube and Reddit and watches every dollar
situations: college freshman in a dorm
community-college student living with parents
high-school senior saving birthday and job money
grad student sharing an apartment
part-time retail worker, 20, living at home

name: Parent buying a gift
description: aged 35 to 60, buying for a teenager or young adult, not a gamer themself, nervous about overspending, relies on the retailer's claims and the kid's wish list
situations: parent of a 14-year-old with a tight holiday budget
two-income family with three kids
single parent working two jobs
grandparent buying for a grandson
dad who has never owned a gaming PC

name: Competitive enthusiast
description: aged 20 to 35, plays ranked shooters or MOBAs most nights, knows terms like power limit, refresh rate and VRAM, distrusts marketing and checks benchmarks before buying
situations: plays ranked FPS every night after work
part-time streamer with a small audience
PC-building hobbyist who owns a desktop
esports club member at university
returning player replacing a broken laptop

name: Work-and-play buyer
description: aged 25 to 45, needs one laptop for remote work or light creative work by day and gaming at night, cares about screen, build and battery, less driven by the lowest price
situations: freelance video editor
software developer working from home
nurse who games after night shifts
high-school teacher who plays on weekends
small-business owner who travels
